reasons: spec.md's Acceptance text ('docs/PROGRESS.md holds only the current record') is unmet on this HEAD, verified directly against the live file: `docs/PROGRESS.md` carries four top-level `# ` headings (the new 'Change 0001' entry plus 'session 18, third sitting', 'session 18, second sitting' and plain 'session 18'), not one. evidence/verifier.md (an earlier, independent pass) traces the extra three to a 'Merge main into sdlc/0001/c' that landed after this change's own split commits ran, not to this change's own edits — so the cause is understood and is not round 4's doing — but round 4's diff (the only thing I was asked to judge) touches only spec.md's verified_with wording and one PROGRESS prose line; it neither closes this gap nor records a decision for it in spec.md's Flagged concerns, unlike the verified_with gap, which this same round did close properly with an owner decision. REVIEW.md's own compliance pass ('the change matches spec.md, plan.md and our design principles') makes a spec/plan mismatch Important by this project's own rule, independent of any reviewer's say-so, and the fix the review-response contemplates (archiving the extra records) is non-trivial — it risks colliding with still-active edits on `main` — so this is a real, open judgment call that belongs in front of the owner, not something a fix round that was never asked to touch it can be read as having settled.

As a secondary, already-expected blast-radius note (not an independent reason to escalate): CLAUDE.md lines 3 and 35 now name `docs/DECISIONS.md` and `docs/NOTES.md`, which this change turned into one-line stub files (verified directly: both now read '# Decisions/Notes — moved ...'). This is an unavoidable, direct consequence of the split and is handled correctly — left unedited (guardrail file this session cannot touch) and proposed via docs/PROGRESS.md's table and evidence/claude-md-proposals.md — so it does not by itself change the verdict, but it is part of what the owner is being asked to read in one sitting alongside the PROGRESS.md gap above.
classification_reasons: Blast radius is large by file count even though the change is docs-only: this round's cumulative branch diff creates/rewrites roughly 100+ files (32 docs/notes/<N>.md, 26 docs/decisions/<N>.md, 22 docs/progress/*.md, three index files, two stubs, four live-doc link updates, plus this change's own evidence/spec files) — not the 'few files' a routine classification requires.

The spec is not fully tight at this HEAD: one Acceptance line (docs/PROGRESS.md 'only the current record') is verified unmet and has no closing decision in spec.md (contrast with the verified_with gap, which round 4 did close with a recorded owner decision), and the CLAUDE.md guardrail edit is still pending the owner's own PR. 'No open concern' does not hold.

No code, schema or contract changes and no risk_list item is touched, and the existing test suite is unaffected by a docs-only diff (build/test/lint green per evidence/test.log, build.log, lint.log and the phase (d) verifier) — this one dimension alone would support routine, but the other two (spec tightness, blast radius) do not, so the plan as a whole is non-routine.
attempted: Intent: compared this round's diff against intent.md's proposed outcome and the owner's PR #112 review comment of 2026-10-03 (evidence/fix-requests.json) asking to waive the verified_with runner requirement and fix a PROGRESS section count; both were exactly what this round's diff does, nothing more, nothing less.

Spec and plan: read spec.md's amended Requirements line 11-13 and the new Flagged-concerns entry ('decided (owner, PR #112 review 2026-10-03, fix round 4): ...') in the diff and confirmed the wording matches the owner's waiver and gives the reasoning; confirmed every other item in Flagged concerns is already closed with a decision. Independently re-checked spec.md's Acceptance text against the live docs/PROGRESS.md and docs/notes/*.md files rather than trusting review-response.md's or review-findings.json's prose, and found the docs/PROGRESS.md 'only the current record' line unmet and not closed by any decision.

Proof: read evidence/test.log, build.log (header lines, exit 0) and evidence/verifier.md (phase (d), an earlier independent pass) rather than trusting any claim in fix-response.md or review-response.md; the verifier's own byte-for-byte checks of the index files, the stub files and the plugin/template/tests scope (empty diff) corroborate the diff's docs-only claim; the same verifier.md already names the PROGRESS.md four-record state and traces it to a merge, independently of this round's own review pass.

Blast radius: confirmed via the diff's file list that no file under plugin/, template/, tests/, .claude/**, CLAUDE.md, REVIEW.md or sdlc.yaml is touched by round 4's actual delta (spec.md, docs/PROGRESS.md, status.yaml only); the large file count belongs to the cumulative split from earlier phases, already reasoned about in plan.md's Risks section.

Policies: checked security-baseline/data-conventions applicability per spec.md (no secret or personal data touched, confirmed by the nature of the edits — a frontmatter wording rule and a section-count correction) and CLAUDE.md's 'Things Claude gets wrong' rules (guardrail file not edited; the proposal was given as a table, confirmed in evidence/claude-md-proposals.md and docs/PROGRESS.md's new table).
Tests: confirmed this round adds no code and therefore no test; confirmed no pre-existing test was touched or weakened (the diff outside changes/ and docs/ is empty for this round's own delta).
